objective: Determine whether the catalogue contains the Fischer SX 7UY-G03 Anchor and Wall Plug with anchor type concrete anchor and diameter 6 mm.

params.brand_token: Fischer brand fragment matched via normalized LOWER/TRIM LIKE on product_variants.brand
params.model_token: one distinctive short fragment of the model/series (e.g. SX 7UY-G03) matched via normalized LOWER/TRIM LIKE on product_variants.product_name/series/model
params.record_path: $first_record.record_path — record_path column of the first matching product_variants row
params.match_count: count of rows returned by the minimal brand+model existence query

constraints.rule: No release of personal information across the boundaries.

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: found -> message contains <YES>; absent -> message contains <NO>
